correctness.rationale: Normalized beta-supported packets; exact positive reset-age difference representation. For 0<sigma<1, the scaled integrand has integrable tail iff 3a>1 and integration by parts gives strictly positive beta coefficient. At sigma=1 exact exponential integral produces the log; at sigma>1 bounded difference quotient permits dominated convergence and gamma curvature. Carefully distinguishes second derivative from mere symmetric quotient and uses even smooth integral away from origin. Checker tests key constants and asymptotic rates; proof handles all parameters.

value.rationale: A sharp all-nonlinearity local regularity phase boundary for a standard physically motivated renewal-reset porous-medium propagator, with explicit fractional/logarithmic/analytic coefficients. This clarifies which contact-local observables and curvature-based descriptions are well-defined; the critical logarithm is not visible from stationary moments. It also differentiates two often-confused nonlinear restarting constructions. Specific original result is not an arbitrary parameter slice or solely a computational example.
